summary: Yale 1735, missionary to the Long Island Indians, then pastor at Bottle Hill (Madison, NJ); John's 1st cousin 9x removed.
bio: Akerly: 'Azariah, a graduate of Yale College, was missionary to the L. I. Indians, and ancestor of the Rev. Theodore L. Cuyler, of Brooklyn'. His daughter Mary married Jacob Morrell. Brevet Brig. Gen. James H. Baker (1829–1913), Ohio and Minnesota Secretary of State, is named a descendant (path not traced; speculative). Survives the James-versus-Joshua dispute (both were Mary's brothers).
